section.53: The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants

53.name_native: The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants

hadiths.text: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that this verse:"Allah keeps those who believe steadfast with firm word in this world and the Hereafter" was revealed in connection with the torment of the grave
